truncate_message: truncate a long message into platform-safe chunks respecting code block boundaries and UTF-16 length limits
extract_media: extract MEDIA:<path> tags and [[audio_as_voice]] directives from response text and return cleaned content
extract_images: extract image URLs from markdown and HTML image tags in response text and return cleaned content
cache_image_from_url: download an image from a URL, validate it is a real image, and cache it locally with SSRF protection
resolve_proxy_url: resolve a proxy URL from environment variables or macOS system proxy settings for platform bot connections
